question: Rua Dona Inês de Castro road class
sql: SELECT names.primary, class FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names.primary = 'Rua Dona Inês de Castro';

question: roads with max speed 30 km/h
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.names.primary FROM lisbon_roads r, UNNEST(r.speed_limits) AS t(sl) WHERE sl.max_speed.value = 30 AND sl.max_speed.unit = 'km/h';

question: paved roads
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.names.primary FROM lisbon_roads r, UNNEST(r.road_surface) AS t(rs) WHERE rs.value = 'paved';

question: roads with common name variant
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.names.primary FROM lisbon_roads r, UNNEST(r.names.rules) AS t(rule) WHERE rule.variant = 'common';

question: roads with exactly one speed limit entry
sql: SELECT id, names.primary FROM lisbon_roads WHERE list_count(speed_limits) = 1;

question: count roads by surface type
sql: SELECT rs.value AS surface, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS road_count FROM lisbon_roads r, UNNEST(r.road_surface) AS t(rs) GROUP BY rs.value ORDER BY road_count DESC, surface;
